description: Calculate your Body Mass Index from height and weight in metric or imperial units. Get your BMI value, weight category and the healthy weight range for your height.

faqs.a: Metric: weight(kg) / height(m)^2. Imperial: 703 x weight(lb) / height(in)^2. Both give the same result.
BMI is a screening tool, not a diagnosis. Muscle mass, age, pregnancy and body composition are not accounted for.
faqs.q: Is BMI an accurate measure of health?

faqs.a: Switch the unit toggle at the top: Metric uses cm and kg, Imperial uses feet/inches and pounds.
faqs.q: How do I switch between metric and imperial?

howto: Your BMI, category and healthy weight range appear instantly.
Toggle between metric and imperial anytime; the category thresholds stay the same.
title: BMI Calculator
